nodes.label: Option A: multi-domaines mono-API
nodes.rationale: Code already used a single API with /domains/{domain}/ routes; per-port model was vestigial. Simple deployment (one service), product/doc consistency, unblocks E4.

nodes.label: Multi-instances par port (alternative ecartee)
nodes.rationale: Rejected: strong isolation at the cost of multiplied processes, config and deployment; incompatible with removal of the multi-instance hack.

nodes.label: Une collection Qdrant, domain comme filtre de payload indexe
nodes.norm_label: une collection qdrant, domain comme filtre de payload indexe
nodes.rationale: Domain was computed in three places (upload tag, ingestion keywords, first tag for BM25) causing empty BM25 on domain queries, invisible non-tech docs and orphan points on reindex. documents.domain becomes the single source; organization_id/document_id/domain indexed in payload.

nodes.label: Fix CORS wildcard + credentials
nodes.rationale: Wildcard origin with allow_credentials=True is invalid in browsers; force credentials off when '*' present.

nodes.label: Indexation transactionnelle SQLite + Qdrant
nodes.rationale: Embeddings computed before the transaction; on Qdrant failure SQLite rolls back, status failed, Celery retry - avoids 'complete' documents without vectors.

nodes.label: Une collection Qdrant, filtres de payload
nodes.norm_label: une collection qdrant, filtres de payload
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenant and multi-domain become indexed filters; no orphan points when a document changes domain. Trade-off: shared HNSW index across organizations.

nodes.label: Flux question (permissions -> dense/BM25 -> RRF -> cross-encoder -> LLM)
nodes.norm_label: flux question (permissions -> dense/bm25 -> rrf -> cross-encoder -> llm)

nodes.label: Limites connues (SQLite, BM25 en memoire, reranker CPU, suivi, detection mots-cles)
nodes.norm_label: limites connues (sqlite, bm25 en memoire, reranker cpu, suivi, detection mots-cles)

nodes.label: Reranker: sigmoide + tri + seuil (fin du melange RRF/min-max)
nodes.norm_label: reranker: sigmoide + tri + seuil (fin du melange rrf/min-max)
nodes.rationale: Min-max normalized reranker score was 1.0 even off-topic; sigmoid gives absolute relevance enabling abstention.

nodes.label: RRF remplace normalisation min-max + alpha
nodes.rationale: RRF uses only ranks: immune to outliers and incompatible scales (cosine vs BM25).

nodes.label: Seuil d'abstention RERANK_MIN_SCORE
nodes.rationale: Sigmoid probability is absolute so the system can say 'nothing relevant' and skip the LLM instead of hallucinating; threshold calibrated on the golden set.

nodes.label: Chunks de 400 tokens + titre de section
nodes.norm_label: chunks de 400 tokens + titre de section
nodes.rationale: Fits the reranker 512-token window; the section title carries context. Trade-off: word-based cuts, not sentence-based.

nodes.label: Cross-encoder bge-reranker-v2-m3 apres fusion
nodes.rationale: Reads question and passage jointly, far more precise than bi-encoder; applied only to top 20 candidates. Trade-off: seconds of CPU latency.

nodes.label: Recherche hybride dense + BM25
nodes.rationale: Dense misses exact identifiers; BM25 misses paraphrases. Trade-off: two indexes to maintain.

nodes.label: Prefixes search_query: / search_document:
nodes.rationale: nomic-embed-text was trained with them; without them retrieval degrades. Changing embedding model requires make reindex.

nodes.label: Permissions appliquees avant la recherche
nodes.rationale: A forbidden document cannot surface, even via the cache; id list passed to Qdrant and BM25.

nodes.label: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60)
nodes.rationale: Fuses ranks, not scores: no normalization, insensitive to outliers. Trade-off: ignores score gap between results.

nodes.label: PERFORMANCE_MODE quality/fast
nodes.rationale: quality enables the reranker; fast disables it with fewer candidates to reduce latency.

nodes.label: Degradation BM25-only si embedding KO
nodes.rationale: Instead of propagating the embedding exception to the router (HTTP 500), hybrid search degrades gracefully to lexical-only results.

nodes.label: Robustesse (fallback BM25, circuit breaker 503, abstention)
nodes.rationale: Embeddings or Qdrant down -> BM25-only; LLM down -> explicit 503 via circuit breaker (fails fast 30s after 5 failures); no relevant chunk -> abstention without LLM call.
